item.title: US and Israel launch joint strike in Iran, US official says
item.description: Israel and the US have launched a joint attack on Iran, officials say. President Trump confirmed the US military began "major combat operations."

item.title: What to know about US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: The attacks came a day after Trump voiced frustration over lack of progress in negotiations to stop Iran's ability to develop nuclear weapons.

item.title: Woman who falsely accused Duke lacrosse players of rape released from prison after murder conviction
item.description: Crystal Mangum made headlines in 2006 for falsely accusing three Duke lacrosse players of rape.

item.title: LAPD increasing security at houses of worship after US attacks Iran; protest to be held in downtown
item.description: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass said police would be providing extra security at local places of worship and other sensitive areas of the city.

item.title: Calabasas teacher charged with molestation, possession of child sexual abuse material
item.description: A Sylmar man who taught at an exclusive private school in Calabasas was charged with possessing of child sexual abuse material, along with annoying or molesting four female students who were allegedly secretly photographed.

item.title: Banning residents fall several months behind on utility payments after new billing software fails
item.description: The failed implementation of new utility billing software in Banning is causing frustration for thousands of residents, as well as for city hall employees.

item.title: FAA enacts new airspace restrictions for helicopters flying near LAX
item.description: Southern California pilots say the Federal Aviation Administration has completely shut down the Los Angles International Airport airspace to all helicopters, including police, fire and medical emergency choppers.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader, is dead, Trump says
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, 86, the supreme leader of Iran, was killed in the U.S.-Israeli attack on the country Saturday, President Donald Trump said.

item.title: Rallies for and against military action in Iran draw demonstrators across Southern California
item.description: While Iranian-Americans celebrated in Westwood, protesters gathered in downtown Los Angeles to oppose the Trump administration's attacks against Iran.

item.title: Dramatic cooldown moves into Southern California this week
item.description: After a week defined by record-breaking heat, Southern California will experience a dramatic cooldown on Monday.
